data.name: Marquis 70 Coronado - Multi Day Charter
data.description: Experience the ultimate in luxury and sophistication aboard the Marquis 70, a stunning motor yacht designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable moments on the water. With its sleek lines, spacious interiors, and top-tier amenities, this yacht offers a premium cruising experience for private gatherings, corporate events, or celebratory occasions.

data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations must be made at least 14 days (336 hours) prior to the start of the reservation for a full refund. Any cancellations made less than 336 hours prior to the start of the reservation are not eligible for refund or rebooking.

Our cancellation policy applies to rebooking date and/or vessel as well.
data.booking_notes:
##What to bring
Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.

MULTI-DAY POLICIES:

**Float Plan**
A float plan must be completed and submitted at the time of booking. Please refer to the confirmation email for the link to your float plan template.
While we require a float plan upon booking, you are able to make alterations to your plan. *Finalized plans must be submitted at least 72 hours prior to your reservation.*
**Fuel**
Fuel is not included in your rental. The fuel tank will be full at the beginning of your rental, and is required to be refilled before your rental's return.
Failure to do so will result in both fuel and labor costs to be charged to the card on file.
**Cancellation Policy**
Cancellation policy: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 14 DAYS (336 hours) prior to your reservation start for a full refund. Once you are within the 14 day window prior to your reservation, no changes or cancellations are permitted. Failure to show for reservation still incurs full rental rate and is not eligible for a refund or reschedule. As the renter, you are responsible for checking the weather forecast and making any desired changes at least 14 days (336 hours) in advance.
**11AM - Charter Begins**
Your charter begins at 11AM on the first day of your scheduled reservation. You will not have access to the boat prior to this. If you require time for provisioning or would like to get an early morning start, please consider scheduling your reservation accordingly.
**9AM - Charter Ends**
Your charter will end at 9AM, the morning after the last day that you have booked.* You will need to have the boat refueled, pumped out, and entirely cleared of all of your belongings by 9AM on this day.
*For example, if you book a 3 days/3 nights charter that starts on 1/1, you would need to be cleared off the boat by 9AM on 1/4.
data.disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
